review_evidence: README gives the project goal of proving Craig interpolation for propositional dynamic logic.
Inspection found 68 Lean files and over 1,600 declaration-shaped items spanning vocabulary, model graphs, tableau constructions, completeness, interpolation, and related bimodal logic.
Files under Unused are not generated copies and may preserve distinct formal lemmas/approaches; path-name status alone is insufficient for lossless exclusion.
summary: Retain lean4-pdl including Bml, Pdl, and Unused: the repository is a large modal/dynamic-logic formalization and even exploratory modules contain independently searchable statements.

review_evidence: Read Pdl.lean in full (1995 bytes): pure top-level import umbrella for the Pdl library (~59 lines) with a docstring identifying it as the library root and linking to the source repo and a dependency-graph SVG -- retained per FILTER-007.

Read Bml/Tableau.lean head (30162 bytes, largest Bml file): real bridging simp-lemma infrastructure (`instance : HasSubset (Finset Formula x Finset Formula)`) with a docstring explaining a Lean-version-specific simp-unfolding regression it works around -- genuine, not filler.

Read Bml/Setsimp.lean in full (2616 bytes, smallest Bml file): six complete theorems/lemmas on Finset union/sdiff/length interactions (`union_singleton_is_insert`, `lengthAdd`, `lengthRemove`, `lengthSetRemove`, `lengthOfEqualSets`, `sum_union_le`), all with complete tactic proofs -- genuine.

Read Bml/Vocabulary.lean in full (3212 bytes): real `def vocabOfFormula`/`vocabOfSetFormula`, a `class HasVocabulary`, two instances, and eight complete theorems on vocabulary monotonicity/preservation under substitution -- genuine.

Read Pdl/Local/Rules.lean head (72017 bytes, largest file in the unit): a real `inductive OneSidedLocalRule` (propositional-logic and program local tableau rules, e.g. `bot`, `not`, `neg`, `con`, `nCo`, `box`, `dia`) with a substantive docstring citing the Haskell prover it corresponds to, followed by a complete theorem `OneSidedLocalRule.heq_of_precond_eq` -- genuine core tableau-calculus content.
Read Pdl/Soundness.lean head (67859 bytes): real lemma `Sequent.mem_toFinset_of_O_eq` and theorem `pdlRuleSat` (soundness of the PDL rules) with a complete, commented case-split proof -- genuine.

Read Pdl/Completeness/TableauGame.lean head (63779 bytes): real docstring (section 6.2 of the paper) explaining the uniform-tableau-game design rationale, followed by player-renaming notation and `inductive ProverPos` -- genuine.

Read Pdl/TableauPath.lean head (60263 bytes): real docstring introducing `PathIn`, the navigation type for tableaux, followed by `inductive PathIn` with three constructors (`nil`, `loc`, `pdl`) -- genuine.

Read Pdl/General/ListFinset.lean in full (984 bytes, smallest file in the unit): genuine Mathlib-adjacent helper lemmas (`def List.toFinFin`, `lemma List.toFinset_map_eq_image`, `lemma List.Vector.tail_last_eq_last`) with a docstring explaining they are general-purpose, not PDL-specific -- confirmed genuine, non-junk.

Read Pdl/Interpolation/Theorem.lean in full (1610 bytes, smallest Interpolation file): the complete `interpolation` theorem (Section 7 of the paper) with a full multi-step tactic proof and its supporting `def Interpolant` -- substantive core result.

Read Pdl/Completeness/Theorem.lean in full (5695 bytes, smallest Completeness file): the complete `completeness` theorem (Theorem 6.1) plus its supporting lemmas `strmg`, `modelExistence`, `Tableau.toUniformViaGame`, `consIffSat`, `singletonConsIffSat`, all with full proofs -- core result, genuine.

Read Pdl/General/Game.lean head (12789 bytes): real docstring introducing a general two-player determined-game theory (culminating in `gamedet`), followed by `inductive Player` and complete theorems on player negation -- genuine, and explicitly PDL-independent reusable infrastructure.

Read Unused/BuildTreeEdge-stuff.lean, Unused/DecidableModel.lean (head), Unused/TransFinWF.lean in full: all contain real declarations (`def`, `inductive`, `structure`, `lemma`, `theorem`); TransFinWF.lean is fully complete (no sorry) well-foundedness machinery explicitly used for tableau-game termination, with a citation to an external reference (EWD1241.PDF); the other two mix complete proofs with sorry-terminated/TODO-marked ones but retain genuine declared statements throughout.

Read Unused/BuildTreeOld.lean head and tail (20728 bytes, the one Unused file not yet read): a real docstring (Section 6.3, 'From winning strategies to model graphs') recording design lessons learned, followed by `inductive BuildTree` with real constructors and further real (if sorry-terminated) definitions -- genuine exploratory content, same pattern as the other three Unused files.

Read scripts/FindUnusedCode.lean head (8217 bytes): real Lean metaprogramming (`def nameCode`, `def printDeps1`, `def printDeps2`, `elab "#deptree" : command`) adapted from a cited Zulip source, producing a Graphviz dependency graph -- real declarations present, does not meet FILTER-004 condition-1, retained as genuine dev-tooling content, consistent with precedent established elsewhere in the corpus for this file type.

Ran grep -LE 'theorem|lemma|def |structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|elab|noncomputable' over exactly the 74 in-scope files (from the brief's file list): exactly 1 file without a declaration keyword -- Pdl.lean, confirmed above as a pure import umbrella, retained per FILTER-007.

Ran a junk-signal grep (lorem ipsum, TODO, FIXME, dummy dummy, XXX unimplemented) over all 74 in-scope files: 0 matches for lorem-ipsum/dummy-dummy/XXX-unimplemented; 42 TODO/FIXME matches, all ordinary in-proof developer comments distributed across 13 files that each independently contain genuine declarations (e.g. Unused/BuildTreeOld.lean 12, Bml/Tableau.lean 6, Pdl/TableauPath.lean 5), not junk markers on otherwise-empty files.
summary: Surveyed all 74 in-scope files: the root Pdl.lean import umbrella, all 12 Bml/* files (propositional modal-logic predecessor development, sampled the largest Tableau.lean, smallest Setsimp.lean, and Vocabulary.lean in full), the Pdl/* PDL tableau/soundness/completeness/interpolation development (sampled the four largest files -- Local/Rules.lean 72017B, Soundness.lean 67859B, Completeness/TableauGame.lean 63779B, TableauPath.lean 60263B -- plus the smallest General/ListFinset.lean and Interpolation/Theorem.lean, Completeness/Theorem.lean, and General/Game.lean), all four Unused/* exploratory files (BuildTreeEdge-stuff.lean, DecidableModel.lean, TransFinWF.lean in full; BuildTreeOld.lean head+tail), and the metaprogramming script scripts/FindUnusedCode.lean. Every sampled file holds genuine formal content: real inductive/structure/theorem/lemma/def declarations with substantive docstrings tying them to specific numbered sections/lemmas of the underlying paper, consistent with the prior review's conclusion that even the exploratory Unused/ directory and TODO/sorry-bearing files contain independently searchable declared statements. The corpus-wide declaration-keyword grep over the exact 74-file scope found exactly one file without a declaration keyword (Pdl.lean, confirmed a pure import umbrella, retained per FILTER-007); the junk-signal grep found only ordinary in-proof TODO/FIXME developer comments scattered across 13 genuine theorem files, no lorem-ipsum/dummy/XXX markers. No new exclusions; this corroborates the prior review's full-retention disposition for the 74 changed/added files.
